verdict.rationale: Convex documents first-party client libraries in JavaScript, Python, iOS Swift, Android Kotlin and Rust, plus framework integrations for React, Next.js, Vue, Svelte, Node.js, Bun and others. It also ships the Convex Auth library and generates end-to-end types in convex/_generated that it promotes for agent-driven development. missing for 10: per-SDK reference documentation or depth beyond a one-line language list, any independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality across languages.
